description: This file defines API routes for a charger simulator service using FastAPI. It contains route handlers for retrieving and updating settings, managing sessions, fetching messages and timelines, and streaming live state updates via SSE and WebSocket. The file also defines data models relevant to settings configuration.

classes.name: SettingsModel
classes.description: Pydantic model representing configuration settings with various parameters related to charger operation and WebSocket security.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] read_settings()
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /settings to retrieve current configuration settings.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] write_settings(payload: SettingsModel)
methods.description: Handles PUT requests at /settings to update configuration settings based on the provided SettingsModel payload.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] sessions_list(status_filter: Optional[str] = None, idTag: Optional[str] = None, connectorId: Optional[int] = None, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /sessions to list sessions with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] session_detail(sessionId: str)
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /sessions/{sessionId} to retrieve detailed information about a specific session.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] session_messages( sessionId: str, limit: int = 200, after: Optional[str] = None, before: Optional[str] = None, action: Optional[str] = None, direction: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /sessions/{sessionId}/messages to list messages for a session with filtering options.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] session_timeline(sessionId: str, limit: int = 1000)
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /sessions/{sessionId}/timeline to retrieve combined timeline data for a session.

methods.name: live_stream()
methods.description: Provides live state updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE) at /live/stream.

methods.name: live_ws(ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint at /live/ws that streams live state updates to connected clients.
